translations.web: I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, O Holy One, because you have judged these things.
translations.bsb: And I heard the angel of the waters say: “Righteous are You, O Holy One, who is and was, because You have brought these judgments.
translations.kjv: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.
translations.asv: And I heard the angel of the waters saying, Righteous art thou, who art and who wast, thou Holy One, because thou didst thus judge:
